hardware: 2 x Intel Xeon E5-2650 v2, 16 physical cores / 32 logical CPUs, 125 GiB RAM; AlmaLinux 8.10 x86-64, Linux 5.15.223
notes: A fresh master and 16 workers per language; one release/native binary. Tokio default multi_thread; Lua concurrency 1; Deno 8 isolates/worker; PHP 8 warm runner threads/worker, max idle 8, ceiling 64; Python one ASGI loop/worker. Symfony prod, debug off, authoritative classmap and warm OPcache. Mimalloc release: purge delay 0, decommit enabled; effective options verified. Access log off. RSS covers the master and workers with all five runtimes loaded; shared pages count per process. Idle observation lasts 120 seconds without forced GC or purge. Mean CPU (µs/request): Rust 69.39, Lua 198.69, Deno 368.42, PHP / Symfony 1007.56, Python / Gufi-ASGI 194.95.
method: GET JSON; restarted master and 16 workers per language; one unchanged release/native binary; all five runtimes loaded in every worker
preflight: 128 warm PHP runner contexts; 16 worker OPcache completions; 65,536 untimed selected-language requests reaching all 16 workers
memory_metric: RSS before/after each case; all five runtimes included; worker mode sums master and workers and counts shared pages per process
cpu_metric: Cumulative process CPU-time delta divided by wall time; 100 percent equals one fully used CPU core
socket_sharing: SO_REUSEPORT; 16 distinct listening sockets verified per run
runtime_logging: warn; bounded startup OPcache completion target at info

allocator.name: mimalloc
allocator.scope: Rust global allocator; no C malloc interposition

isolation: Private Linux network, PID, IPC and mount namespaces; private loopback and tmpfs SHM; sources read-only; benchmark logs and PHP cache writable
cpu_per_request_metric: Sum of master and worker CPU-time deltas in microseconds divided by completed HTTP responses; includes background runtime work
